examples.english: You see, my dearly beloved, a holy young man imitated the apostles and became like them, according to what the Lord said to his apostles, whom he resembled, ‘He who keeps my commandments will make all the signs that I have made.’
examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1

examples.english: If a man hath struck thee a blow, bear it at his hands, and rejoice ; set thy hope in God, and He will do what is good for thee.
examples.source: Instructions of Apa Pachomius in MERC.AR in Budge ed. - part 1

examples.english: And I spoke to the people in the morning, as he commanded me in the evening, and I did in the morning as it was commanded me.

And he made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
